description: List the key NAMES already stored in your organization's encrypted secrets vault — never the values (no tool returns a secret value). Use this to (a) reuse an existing key instead of requesting a new one, and (b) poll whether a request_secret ask has been fulfilled by the human. Generated code reads a secret at RUNTIME with renderClient.getSecretVal({ key }) — the build ships key names only.

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.
